scope: G09 acceptance and its G05/G07 handoff; other release, correctness, package and cross-engine contracts retain their own policies

production.measurement: Presented-workload frame pacing and end-to-end runtime evidence; GPU pass sums, serial fence wall time and headless throughput alone cannot qualify
production.persistentRegression: Review reproducibility, paired uncertainty, absolute milliseconds and impact on the registered production target together; a relative percentage alone cannot reject a candidate

requiredEvidence.requirement: Complete F0-F8 correctness, full-image parity, errors, lifecycle and device recovery on the selected native path
Preregister representative production profiles and validate complete frame pacing, long frames, cold startup and steady operation; retain all rounds
Long-run resource bounds, pending retirement and zero cleanup residue; no sustained growth, hangs or repeated stutter
Representative A/B1/B2/B3/B4 attribution with at least one measured production benefit; separate CPU, GPU, waiting, allocation and bandwidth proxies
Same-candidate G05 and clean registered G07 evidence, including unchanged independent release contracts

historicalEvidence: Preserve original results and protocol bytes. New interpretation never relabels a legacy failure as a pass or promotes diagnostic samples to a release baseline.
